definitions.general_entity_preferences: Preferences for object categories, including the appearance of a display or embedded artwork.
definitions.scene_preferences: Preferences for the background and environmental attributes of a specified scene; includes sky, setting, environmental light, walls, ground and support surfaces.
definitions.global_preferences: Image-level visual treatment preferences; original genre or use conditions remain applicable. Their existence does not activate an edit, require cross-image reuse, or override scene preferences.

preservation: Basic biographies and non-global knowledge unchanged; only the 125 global options are generalized across subjects.
activation: The request, image and available knowledge must support the actual edit; a general request to tidy an image does not activate background or global changes.
